metro.title: Tehran Metro travel time
metro.subtitle: Pick any two stations on Tehran's seven metro lines to see how long the trip takes, where to change, and watch the train make the journey.
metro.disclaimer: Tehran Metro has no public live feed, so this is worked out from the published station timetable, not from real train positions. Delays and crowding are not reflected.
metro.sourceNote: (station timetable). The diagram is schematic, not to scale.

result.label: Estimated travel time
result.waitHint: Half the gap between trains, for each train you board
result.totalHint: From the first platform to arrival
result.totalWithoutWalk_one: Plus walking at {{n}} change — not in the timetable yet
result.totalWithoutWalk_other: Plus walking at {{n}} changes — not in the timetable yet
result.changeUnknown: Change at {{station}} — walking time not in the timetable
result.changeKnown: Change at {{station}} — about {{walk}} min on foot
result.routesHint: Routes with fewer unmeasured walks are suggested first — the planner won't guess how long a change takes.

errors.UNKNOWN_STATION: “{{id}}” is not a station on this line.
errors.SAME_STATION: Origin and destination are the same — pick two different stations.
errors.MISSING_SEGMENT_TIME: The timetable has no running time between {{a}} and {{b}}, so there is no estimate for this ride.
errors.MISSING_DWELL_TIME: The timetable is missing the dwell time at stations, so there is no estimate for this ride.
errors.NO_SERVICE_DATA: There is no timetable for this day type, so the wait can't be estimated.
errors.MISSING_HEADWAY: The timetable has no headway for this time, so the wait can't be estimated.
errors.OUT_OF_SERVICE: No trains at this time. Trains leave this station between {{first}} and {{last}}.
errors.INVALID_TIME: Enter a time as HH:MM to estimate the wait.
errors.INVALID_LINE_DATA: The timetable data for this line is invalid.
errors.NO_ROUTE: No route between {{from}} and {{to}} in the timetable data.

game2048.tagline: Merge matching tiles to double them. Reach 2048 to win — then keep going for a bigger score.

howTo.title: How to play
howTo.keys: Use the arrow keys or WASD to slide every tile in one direction.
howTo.swipe: On a phone, swipe across the board — up, down, left or right.
howTo.goal: Two tiles with the same number merge into one worth double.
howTo.hint: Your score and board are saved locally, so you can pick up where you left off.

win.title: You made 2048!
win.body: That's the goal reached. Keep going for a higher score, or start fresh.

lose.title: No moves left
lose.body: The board is full and nothing else can merge. You finished on {{score}}.
